title: I added so much new stuff on Tiny World
author: Spirited_Carpet5109
selftext: Whats up guys I added a ton of stuff to my new online browser game Tiny World on [tavamadethis.com](http://tavamadethis.com) . You can now create your own account with a pfp, DMs, world chat, mini games, shops, economy system, and so much more. It genuinely a fun game I would really appreciate it if yall could just click the link and try it for completely free. Im open to any feedback or ideas on what to add and I hope yall like the game. My favorite is flying the drone around the maps. Add me as a friend on Tiny World I will add yall back my name is Tava. Remember to create your own unique name and pin to claim your account forever. Thanks everyone!
